name: guide-frame

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @guideframe/core && npm run build --workspace @guideframe/react && npm run build --workspace guideframe-demo
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run type-check && npm run build
scripts.format: biome format --write packages examples package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages examples package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome lint packages examples package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.publish:beta: npm run build --workspace @guideframe/core && npm run build --workspace @guideframe/react && npm publish --workspace @guideframe/core --tag beta && npm publish --workspace @guideframe/react --tag beta
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @guideframe/core && npm run test --workspace @guideframe/react
scripts.type-check: npm run typecheck --workspace @guideframe/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @guideframe/react && npm run typecheck --workspace guideframe-demo

author: Dinil Thilakarathne
description: Framework-agnostic layout grids, rulers, and draggable guides for browser development.
